correctness.rationale: At I=m^r in R_d=⊕_{q≥0}C[u,v]_{dq}, minimal generators g_i=u^{dr-i}v^i (0≤i≤dr) and Q=R_d/I have socle Q_{r-1}. Applying u^d g_{i+1}=u^{d-1}vg_i to any homogeneous image h_i∈Q_t, t<r−1, gives u h_{i+1}=v h_i as actual binary-polynomial identities (no truncation in degree t+1<r). Iteration forces u^{dr}|h_0 while deg h_0=dt<dr; hence all such h_i vanish. Every map I/mI→Q_{r−1} extends R-linearly because m annihilates target. Therefore tangent Hom_R(I,Q) has dimension (dr+1)(d(r−1)+1), colength r+dr(r−1)/2, and character Σ_{i,j}U^{i−j−d}V^{j−i}; no hidden lower grades. In d=2 A1 case tangent dimension 4r²−1 versus known local dimension 2r² gives singularity for r≥1. I independently enumerated all monomial lower-grade relations over 30 (d,r) parameter pairs; finite check is corroboration, not the general proof. Critical external input: reduced Hilbert scheme on A1 surface dimension 2N.
